name: Fullback Blast
situation: 3rd & 1, own 40, short yardage after sweep success

summary.motive: Punish defenses that over-play the sweep by handing to the fullback between the tackles off identical footwork.
summary.whyItWorks: The sweep fake removes both flow defenders while the ISO combo physically removes the Mike, leaving one uncovered gap for the fullback.
summary.failureMode: Linebackers stay home on the sweep look and the Mike defeats the combo block before the fullback reaches the hole.

beats.title: 1. Identical Sweep Footwork
beats.text: The quarterback opens with the exact same steps as Power Sweep Left and the halfback crosses on the same path. Every linebacker keys the sweep flow immediately.

beats.title: 2. The Ball Changes Direction
beats.text: At the last moment the quarterback pulls the ball back and hands to the fullback diving up the middle. The Will and weak corner are already committed left.

beats.title: 3. The ISO Combo Arrives
beats.text: The guard and center climb off their double-team directly onto the Mike linebacker — the classic isolation block that defines this companion play.

beats.title: 4. Through the Filled Hole
beats.text: With the Mike driven off the ball and both flow defenders chasing the decoy, the fullback falls forward through the vacated A/B gap for the conversion.

relations.tell: The fullback takes the ball instead of leading it — every true sweep shows the fullback blocking on the perimeter.
